description:
Full time equivalent (FTE) from groups of staff and their weekly hours.

    Use for: 'fte calculator', 'how to calculate fte nz', 'what is 0.8 fte',
    'full time equivalent staff', 'fte for funding application', 'headcount to fte'.

    FTE = total weekly hours / full time week (default 40). 3 x 40 h, 2 x 20 h and
    1 x 30 h is 4.75 FTE, headcount 6. No legal full time week in New Zealand;
    Stats NZ full time is 30+ hours a week.

    Args:
        groups: [{"staff": n, "hours_each": h}, ...].
        full_time_hours: The full time week, default 40.

    Returns:
        total_fte, headcount, total_weekly_hours, average_fte_per_person, annual_hours,
        and staff counted full or part time by Stats NZ.
name: fte_calculator
